seo.title: Taunton Barber Van | Mobile Barber in Taunton
seo.description: A proper barbershop built into the back of a van. Lewis comes to your door across Taunton and the villages around it. Skin fades, scissor cuts, beard trims and kids' cuts. Rated 5.0 from 58 Google reviews. WhatsApp or call 07475 512586.

phone.whatsappText: Hi Lewis, I'd like to book a cut.

hero.label: Mobile barber · Taunton
hero.line: A proper barbershop built into the back of a van. Lewis comes to you.

van.label: The van
van.heading: No queue. No waiting room. Nobody dragged into
paragraphs: Oak panelling, one black chair, a round mirror and a fridge of cold water. Everything a good barbershop has, parked outside your front door.
One barber, one chair, one customer at a time. Lewis takes his time, listens to what you want, and tells you straight what will suit you.

steps.title: Message Lewis
steps.body: WhatsApp is quickest. Say what you're after and roughly when.

steps.title: Agree a time and place
steps.body: Home, work, wherever suits. Lewis confirms a slot and the price.

steps.title: The van turns up
steps.body: Step in, sit down, step out sharp. Nobody goes anywhere.

families.label: Families
families.heading:
Three kids.
One doorstep.
paragraphs: Parents book Lewis for a reason. Nobody sits in a waiting room while their brother has his turn. Nobody gets marched round Taunton on a Saturday. The van parks up, each of them takes the chair, and the afternoon carries on.
Patient with the nervous ones. Easy to talk to for the ten-year-olds with opinions. Dads get a cut while the van's there.

quote.text: my 10 year old even commented how he liked how easy he was to talk with
quote.author: Jennifer Jackson
